trust_decision.summary: Published fix: FunctionsBuilder::cast/extract/datePart/dateAdd accept a caller-supplied type/part/unit string that is put into SQL as a raw 'literal' token; the fix requires it to match ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$ (ensureSimpleString). MIS-PINNED: the pinned tree is the 2013 3.0-dev pre-image of 4730e774 (a non-security refactor that renamed FunctionsTrait to FunctionsBuilder). None of cast/extract/datePart/dateAdd exist here, so the flaw is absent at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The summary names FunctionsBuilder. At the pinned commit that is FunctionsTrait (there is no src/Database/FunctionsBuilder.php), and it has no cast/extract/datePart/dateAdd methods.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API $query->func()->cast($field, $type) (4.x; the file is absent at the pinned commit)
public API $query->func()->extract($part, $expr), and datePart(), which delegates to it (absent at the pinned commit)
public API $query->func()->dateAdd($expr, $value, $unit) (absent at the pinned commit)
public API $query->func()->cast($field, $dataType) (5.x; absent at the pinned commit)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: there is no vulnerable site at the pinned commit to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: At the pinned commit, the Postgres dialect deliberately emits literal type tokens ('date', 'time', ' 0 ') through FunctionExpression::add(... => 'literal'). Validating literal keys inside FunctionExpression::add would break this (' 0 ' has spaces). The behaviour exists, but there is no published-fix sink here to pair it with.

O6_input_shapes: string type/part/unit (fix.diff:138-144). In 4.x cast(), an empty type is rejected before the check (fix.diff:76-80). Not applicable at the pinned commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add to the trait the later upstream helpers (extract/dateAdd/cast) that put a caller string in as a 'literal' key, i.e. replant the whole published flaw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Upstream later added exactly these methods to this class, but this would be a planted vulnerability, not the advisory's real code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: func($name, ...) puts $name into SQL verbatim (FunctionExpression.php:132). This is a raw name by design, as documented.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Arbitrary function names are an intended raw API. It would be argued out of scope as 'by design', and the published fix kept it raw.

O9_family: CWE-89 SQL injection via unvalidated SQL keyword/identifier tokens passed as raw literals in a query builder

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 5.4-era CakePHP 3.0-dev with PHPUnit 3.7-era tests (very old; hard to run on a modern PHP)
services: database for integration tests (sqlite possible); unit tests for FunctionsTrait need none
O10_build.project_tests: Cake/Test/TestCase/Database/FunctionsTraitTest.php. The fix's tests/TestCase/Database/FunctionsBuilderTest.php does not exist at the pinned commit.

j.j_sites_touched: src/Database/FunctionsBuilder.php (absent at the pinned commit; the pinned tree has Cake/Database/FunctionsTrait.php)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or validate every 'literal' key centrally in FunctionExpression::add, which breaks the dialect's own literal tokens.

out_of_scope_notes: The pin is wrong: parent_commit is the parent of 4730e774 (a 2013 refactor, not a security fix). The real fix pre-images are the 4.x/5.x parents of 3f4d13ea/79e1d6bc and 8699d6f3/ab608711/3349584c. The 6 listed commits are 3 duplicate pairs plus that one unrelated commit.

If re-pinned to the 4.x/5.x parent: 3 methods plus datePart (which delegates to extract), all in one file. These are where-type routes of one concept and would fall together. Little how-type room is expected, though that is unverified at those commits.
unverified: Repository size in MB was not measured.

The 4.x/5.x pre-fix trees were not examined (they are not checked out). Any O2/O8 routes there (e.g. other FunctionsBuilder or dialect methods that take raw literal strings, such as dialect transforms of DATE_ADD/EXTRACT units) are unknown.
That datePart() delegates to extract() in 4.x/5.x is inferred from the fix tests (fix.diff:195-200), not from code.
present_in_latest is not applicable: no latest release was provided.
